title: How Deeply Does Your Personality Align with League of Legends?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover how closely your inner traits mirror the spirit of League of Legends champions and gameplay!

questions.text: When you join a new gaming group, you tend to...

options.text: Immediately ask about the group’s regular strategies and role assignments
Strike up conversations with everyone, sharing your favorite in-game moments
Imagine epic team plays and unique combo ideas you could try together
Observe quietly first, waiting to find someone with similar playstyles to connect with

questions.text: During a chaotic team fight, your first instinct is to...

options.text: Scan the map for hidden enemies or incoming jungle ambushes
Shout out clear commands to coordinate your team’s next moves
Focus on your own targets and execute your role without distraction
Predict the enemy’s next rotation to set up a game-changing trap

questions.text: If your team is losing badly, you’re most likely to...

options.text: Cheer up your teammates with encouraging jokes and motivational lines
Double down on your original strategy, trusting it will turn the tide
Calmly point out specific mistakes and suggest immediate fixes
Adapt your playstyle to a more defensive, utility-focused role

questions.text: When you discover a new champion, you tend to...

options.text: Invent your own unique playstyle that no one else seems to use
Ask your friends for tips and tricks they’ve learned with the champion
Spend time in the practice tool mastering every ability before playing ranked
Watch pro player matches to copy their exact combos and positioning

questions.text: After a hard-fought victory, you usually...

options.text: Reflect on the key plays that led to your success, noting what to repeat
Post about your win on social media, tagging your teammates to celebrate together
Immediately jump into the next game to keep your winning streak going
Treat yourself to a snack or break, savoring the moment of triumph

questions.text: When faced with an unexpected enemy gank, you...

options.text: Turn the gank around by baiting the enemy into a trap you set
Stick to your pre-planned escape route without hesitation
Quickly use your escape abilities and retreat to safety
Panic slightly but follow your team’s call to either fight or flee

questions.text: You’re most drawn to champions who...

options.text: Dominate the battlefield with high damage and strategic plays
Offer flexible playstyles that adapt to any team composition
Protect allies and turn team fights around with supportive abilities
Have a clear, defined role that excels at specific game objectives

questions.text: When planning a team objective like Baron Nashor, you...

options.text: Lead the charge, scouting the area and calling out enemy positions
Imagine all possible enemy interference scenarios and plan countermeasures
Stay back and provide vision with wards, ensuring no surprises
Calculate the exact time it will take to secure Baron, coordinating with your jungler

questions.text: If a teammate makes a critical mistake, you’re likely to...

options.text: Remind the team to stick to the original plan to minimize further errors
Explain what went wrong and how to avoid it next time
Adjust your play to cover their mistake and keep the game going
Send a kind message reassuring them it’s just one play

questions.text: When you have free time outside of ranked games, you...

options.text: Study champion lore, diving deep into their backstories and motivations
Practice last-hitting and ability accuracy in the practice tool
Host custom games with friends, creating silly rules for fun
Design your own custom champion concepts with unique abilities

questions.text: When you’re trailing in gold, you prefer to...

options.text: Farm quietly in your lane, focusing on minimizing gold gaps
Roam around the map, ganking lanes to catch up on kills
Trick the enemy into overextending, setting up surprise team fights
Target enemy objectives like turrets or dragons to gain map control

questions.text: Your ideal gaming session is one where you...

options.text: Stick to a set list of champions you know you can play perfectly
Try out new and unpredictable champion combinations
Play with a close group of friends, chatting and laughing throughout
Focus on climbing the ranked ladder, setting a clear win goal for the session

results.title: Strategic Grandmaster (INTJ)
results.description: You’re the mastermind behind every winning play, just like a pro team’s coach. You analyze meta trends, map out long-term strategies, and never lose sight of the end goal. Your quiet confidence and sharp logic turn losing games into comebacks, and you thrive on outthinking every opponent. You’re an INTJ—calculating, visionary, and unshakable in your pursuit of ranked glory.

results.title: Unconventional Innovator (INTP)
results.description: You’re the player who invents wild, never-before-seen champion combos that leave enemies confused and teammates amazed. You hate following the meta, preferring to experiment with off-meta builds and playstyles. Your curious mind loves solving complex in-game problems, and you turn every match into a creative challenge. You’re an INTP—innovative, analytical, and endlessly curious.

results.title: Dominant Team Leader (ENTJ)
results.description: You’re the natural shotcaller who rallies the team to victory with clear commands and unwavering confidence. You take charge of every objective, assign roles strategically, and hold everyone accountable for their performance. Your decisive nature and ability to think on your feet make you a force to be reckoned with in every ranked game. You’re an ENTJ—assertive, strategic, and born to lead.

results.title: Trickster Playmaker (ENTP)
results.description: You thrive on chaos, using your quick wit and unpredictable moves to outplay enemies at every turn. You love baiting opponents into traps, pulling off fake engages, and keeping everyone guessing your next move. Your outgoing personality makes you the life of the gaming group, and you turn every match into an exciting adventure. You’re an ENTP—witty, adaptive, and a natural chaos agent.

results.title: Empathetic Support Main (INFJ)
results.description: You’re the heart of the team, always looking out for your teammates and ensuring everyone feels supported. You excel at reading the room (and the map), knowing when to heal, shield, or encourage your allies. Your deep understanding of others makes you a master at coordinating team plays that bring out the best in everyone. You’re an INFJ—compassionate, intuitive, and the glue that holds the team together.

results.title: Lore-Driven Idealist (INFP)
results.description: You play League of Legends for the stories behind the champions, not just the ranked points. You connect deeply with characters who fight for justice or protect the vulnerable, and your playstyle reflects your values. You’re quiet but passionate, and you bring a sense of purpose to every match. You’re an INFP—idealistic, creative, and guided by your inner moral compass.

results.title: Inspiring Shotcaller (ENFJ)
results.description: You lead with empathy and enthusiasm, motivating your teammates to play their best even when the odds are stacked against you. You celebrate every small win, comfort teammates after mistakes, and turn stressful matches into fun, shared experiences. Your ability to unite people and foster teamwork makes you a beloved leader in any gaming group. You’re an ENFJ—charismatic, compassionate, and a natural motivator.

results.title: Adventurous Playmaker (ENFP)
results.description: You love trying new champions and playstyles, turning every match into a new adventure. You’re always excited to share your latest in-game discoveries with friends, and your upbeat energy is contagious. You thrive on spontaneity, preferring to adapt to the moment rather than follow a strict plan. You’re an ENFP—optimistic, creative, and always ready for a new challenge.

results.title: Reliable Tactician (ISTJ)
results.description: You’re the player everyone can count on to show up prepared and execute their role flawlessly. You follow proven strategies, stick to your lane, and never cut corners when it comes to practice. Your consistency and attention to detail make you a rock-solid teammate, and you excel at turning small, steady wins into ranked progress. You’re an ISTJ—dependable, detail-oriented, and committed to excellence.

results.title: Nurturing Guardian (ISFJ)
results.description: You’re the unsung hero of every team, always putting your teammates’ needs before your own. You excel at supportive roles, healing allies, placing wards, and ensuring everyone stays safe. Your quiet dedication and caring nature make you a favorite teammate, and you find joy in helping others succeed. You’re an ISFJ—kind, reliable, and always looking out for the group.

results.title: Disciplined Rank Climber (ESTJ)
results.description: You approach ranked gaming with military precision, setting clear goals and sticking to a strict routine to achieve them. You value structure and order, and you expect your teammates to follow suit. Your no-nonsense attitude and focus on results make you a formidable opponent, and you climb the ladder with steady, consistent progress. You’re an ESTJ—organized, decisive, and driven to win.

results.title: Team Spirit Champion (ESFJ)
results.description: You play League of Legends for the social connection, loving every chance to bond with friends over shared wins and losses. You’re always the first to congratulate a teammate on a great play or cheer them up after a bad one. Your warm, outgoing personality makes you the life of any gaming group, and you turn every match into a fun, memorable experience. You’re an ESFJ—sociable, caring, and the ultimate team player.

results.title: Adaptive Mechanic (ISTP)
results.description: You’re the player who can pick up any champion and master it in no time, thanks to your quick reflexes and hands-on approach. You thrive on fast-paced fights and unexpected situations, using your technical skills to outmaneuver enemies. You prefer to show, not tell, letting your in-game actions speak for themselves. You’re an ISTP—practical, quick-thinking, and a master of in-game mechanics.

results.title: Artistic Skirmisher (ISFP)
results.description: You play League of Legends like it’s an art form, drawn to champions with flashy abilities and dynamic playstyles. You value self-expression, using your champion’s unique moves to create beautiful, unexpected plays. You’re quiet but passionate, and you find joy in the creative freedom of every match. You’re an ISFP—creative, spontaneous, and a natural artist of the rift.

results.title: Daring Bruiser (ESTP)
results.description: You love diving into the thick of battle, taking risks that leave enemies stunned and teammates cheering. You thrive on adrenaline, preferring fast-paced fights over slow, strategic plays. Your outgoing personality and love of action make you a fun teammate, and you turn every match into an exciting thrill ride. You’re an ESTP—bold, impulsive, and always ready for a fight.

results.title: Vibrant Juggernaut (ESFP)
results.description: You’re the most energetic player in every game, bringing laughter and excitement to every match. You love playing flashy, high-impact champions that draw attention and make a statement. You live in the moment, enjoying every second of the game whether you win or lose. Your outgoing, fun-loving nature makes you a hit with every gaming group. You’re an ESFP—sociable, spontaneous, and the life of the rift.
